executionFacts: GrowTree pretranslates child by parent working-original delta, uses overlapfactor then sets child center from parent working+(child original-parent original)*factor, recurses immediately before next sibling.

DepthFirstCompaction first compacts all descendant subtrees, then moves each child subtree in input order. Native call-local state replaces source static root/svg/orthogonal scratch without changing math or public scope.
minUnderlapWithSubtree iterates descendants of the moving subtree, not its root; boundary-direction hit sets zero and breaks only that recursion level. Do not replace with all-pairs rectangle bounds.
Orthogonal choice uses abs(x)>=abs(y), zeros the other axis, conditionally rescales only for strict transverse overlap. Negative scaling and zero/Infinity normalization are not clamped.

Scanline source active-set iteration includes the current node: same-node overlap returns false and if overlapsFound already true this can trigger the original early break. Never filter self before the loop.
Scanline high timestamps precede low at equal Y; active set comparator is rect.x then originalVertex.x/y with total Double comparison, comparator-zero add throws the literal Invalid hitboxes message.

OverlapRemoval optional underlying provider executes before begin, then source forces CENTER_NODE/INVERTED_OVERLAP/MINIMUM_TREE, scanline if enabled, Delaunay/selectedtree/GrowTree, updateGraph and actual overlaps flag; source maxIterations64 is configurable source termination, not a new native cap.
ShrinkTree outer provider has no begin/done; its actual child monitor begins Compaction by shrinking a tree. Do not add a successful outer diagnostics task name.

All dynamic processor configurations here are empty; actual static phase order is Delaunay, selected min/max spanning tree, selected Grow/Shrink execution. Do not claim full generic assembler support.
